newsitem.title: INDIA: Flash flood hits India village.
newsitem.headline: Flash flood hits India village.

text.p: A flash flood swept through a village in northern India and dozens of people may have been killed, a news agency and officials said.

United News of India (UNI) said about 40 people were feared drowned after the Andhra River burst its banks and flooded Chirgaon village in Himachal Pradesh state. Local police told Reuters they did not know the number of casualties.
UNI said 15 to 20 people were injured in the sudden flooding which was triggered by a monsoon cloudburst in the Himalayan region.
The news agency said raging river water damaged many buildings in Chirgaon and washed away roads.
Police in the state capital Shimla, speaking to Reuters by telephone in neighbouring Jammu and Kashmir state, said authorities were still awaiting details on casualties and damage.
Senior state officials were in a meeting to discuss the flooding, they said.
